scope: Red, blue, green monochromatic paint on armor plates; shared unchanged head; cosmetic variants of one model.

entries.label: Rouge
entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: a COLOR VARIANT of the supplied Project RL Bastion VERY HEAVY simplified BODY MODULE BA-W01-P05-r03. Image 1 is the edit target and exact design to preserve. User requests monochromatic painted ARMOR PLATES. Change ONLY the paint color of ALL the warm ivory and rust-orange RIGID ARMOR PLATES: shoulder shells, breastplate, collar/abdomen protective plate, upper-arm shells, forearm guards, gauntlet knuckle shells, thigh/knee/shin shells and armored boot shells. Repaint EVERY formerly orange plate insert to the SAME requested hue as the rest of the plates, so there are no ivory or orange secondary accents left on the armor. Keep all dark charcoal flexible underlayer, joint gaps, finger glove areas, belt, soles and the normal human neck skin EXACTLY unchanged. Keep the existing clear big material masses and low detail level. Monochromatic means ONE paint hue across the whole plate set, with natural lighter/darker shading of that hue for volume, not flat solid color. It is matte painted industrial armor, no neon, bloom, emissive light or activated effect. Preserve the EXACT original geometry, silhouette, all plate borders, pose, human build, neck position, proportions, five-finger hands, boots, framing, alpha edges, highlights and shadow placement. Do not redesign anything, add details, add texture, move limbs or change body scale. No head or face can be added: this remains the same headless neck-to-boots body component, since an identical shared head is assembled separately for every variation. Do not color skin, cloth or dark articulation joints. ONE complete body module on the same genuine transparent alpha background, no floor, cast shadow, backdrop, checkerboard, labels or text. PAINT HUE: a strong matte crimson red, lighter scarlet planes and dark burgundy shadow planes of the SAME red hue; no orange highlights.
